summary: Routeora is a complete, production-minded full-stack implementation: all 6 backend routes, all 7 frontend pages, docker-compose, README, and 33 passing tests — one non-blocking security finding (JWT_SECRET fallback to 'dev-secret' should be replaced with a startup assertion).
findings: JWT_SECRET falls back to 'dev-secret' in src/routes/auth.ts (lines 32, 65) and src/middleware/auth.ts (line 28); any deployment where this env var is unset silently accepts forged tokens — replace with a startup assertion that throws when NODE_ENV is not 'test' and JWT_SECRET is absent.
